risk_note: Pinduoduo purchase jump (D10-2817 / D10-2819 / D10-2820, BR-ATTR-27). Before: the open answer for a Pinduoduo purchase had a single h5 step (mobile_url) on every client, because the scheme step was only self-built from a contracts/apps.json scheme that Pinduoduo never declared, and the conversion's schema_url was never used. Now the Pinduoduo purchase scheme step is the schema_url of this conversion verbatim, only when it is a non-empty string starting with the declared Pinduoduo scheme plus ://; otherwise there is no scheme step. Order follows the BR-ATTR-27 default matrix: installed [scheme, h5], not installed [h5], unknown merged; H5 / web are fixed to unknown (BR-ATTR-27 ①②) and get the same [scheme, h5] for Pinduoduo purchases only. The jump cache variant changed for every client and installed value (p2), so entries built before the change miss once and are converted again. contracts/apps.json Pinduoduo entry: status verified (Android real-device evidence), ios.query_schemes [pinduoduo], android.packages [com.xunmeng.pinduoduo], harmony.query_schemes stays [] (not verified); bridge.gen.ts regenerated. Production admission is unchanged: VERIFIED_JUMP_PATHS in app.module.ts is still empty. JD, Taobao and the Pinduoduo authorization page (D10-662) are unchanged, except that with a declared scheme the authorization page derives a scheme step when the authority answer has no schema_url (D10-662 behaviour, now reachable). p_id and custom_parameters are carried verbatim in both steps. No money, order, ledger or db code touched.
